limitations: Physical posted-book samples at explicit checkpoints are not continuous outage durations or executable supply guarantees.
Timing measures sequential helper-wrapped order intake and worker refresh calls, excluding replay/checkpoint time; concurrent/racing direct requests are not in these timing/quantity aggregates.
All functional scenario invariant checks and current-version reconciliation must pass; no loss-quality, spread, fill-rate, outage or latency release threshold is selected.
Random fixture IDs and concurrent commit order can change across executions. Fixed operation sequences/settings and source hashes are retained; #71 synthetic seed traces are separate.
The eight #71 MM setting candidates use well-funded 100000 Coin test wallets; these cases do not model the S/population constraint.
The exact final #133 approved launch settings must be rerun for #149.
